messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int arr[1001];
int n;
int ans;
int itv;

int Get(int pos)
{
	int ret = 0;
	for(int i = pos; i < n; ++ i)
	{
		if(arr[i] <= itv + arr[pos])
			ret ++;
	}
	return ret;
}

int main()
{
#if _MSC_VER == 1500
	freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);
#endif
	scanf("%d", &n);
	for(int i = 0; i < n; ++ i)
		scanf("%d", arr + i);
	sort(arr, arr + n);
	scanf("%d", &itv);
	ans = 0;
	for(int i = 0; i < n; ++ i)
		ans = max(ans, Get(i));
	printf("%d\n", ans);
	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
